description: This file implements the core logic for the SystemAudioPlayer plugin, including handling of audio playback commands (Open, Play, Stop, etc.), configuration, session management, event dispatching, and resource control for the audio player components within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: SystemAudioPlayerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing the ISystemAudioPlayer interface, managing audio sessions, handling commands, event dispatching, and resource management for the system's audio player.

classes.name: AudioPlayer
classes.description: Represents individual audio playback instances, providing controls for playback, configuration, and status querying.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin, currently a stub returning success.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink to receive events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification sink.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Starts a new audio session with specified parameters and returns a session ID.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Configures a specific audio session identified by ID, such as PCM parameters or WebSocket security.

methods.name: GetPlayerSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a session ID for a given URL.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Starts playback of a given URL on a specified session.

methods.name: PlayBuffer
methods.description: Plays raw buffer data on a specified session.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops playback on a specified session.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes and cleans up a session identified by ID.

methods.name: SetMixerLevels
methods.description: Adjusts the mixer volume levels for a session.

methods.name: SetSmartVolControl
methods.description: Configures smart volume control parameters for a session.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses playback in a session.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes playback in a session.

methods.name: IsPlaying
methods.description: Checks if playback is ongoing for a session.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Internal method to dispatch plugin events asynchronously.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Broadcasts events to all registered notification clients.

methods.name: onSAPEvent
methods.description: Handles SAP events and triggers notification dispatch.

methods.name: extractSecurityParams
methods.description: Extracts WebSocket security parameters from JSON config.

methods.name: OpenMapping
methods.description: Creates a new AudioPlayer object and maps it with a session ID.

methods.name: GetSessionFromUrl
methods.description: Finds session ID corresponding to a URL.

methods.name: SameModeNotPlaying
methods.description: Prevents concurrent playback modes; stops other sessions with the same mode.

methods.name: CloseMapping
methods.description: Deletes a session and associated AudioPlayer object.

methods.name: getObjectFromMap
methods.description: Retrieves the AudioPlayer instance for a given session ID.
